title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

title: Last Week Tonight‘s John Oliver says he won‘t placate prediction markets users

summary: While the regulator under Atkins has dropped several cases against crypto companies, the SEC still awaits passage of a market structure bill to clarify its authority over crypto.

title: Bitmine buys 101,627 ETH in largest purchase since December 2025

title: Japan to test government bonds as digital collateral on Canton
